from pathlib import Path
progdir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u064/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    half = w // 2
    frame = grid[0][0]
    separators = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == frame for c in range(half))]
    bands = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(separators, separators[1:]) if b > a + 1]

    # Record each left-side cavity as a translated set of cells.
    cavities = []
    for top, bottom in bands:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(top, bottom) for c in range(half) if grid[r][c] == 0]
        if cells:
            min_r = min(r for r, c in cells)
            min_c = min(c for r, c in cells)
            shape = frozenset((r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in cells)
            cavities.append((cells, shape))

    # Find same-color objects on the right and compare their shapes independent of position.
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(half, w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                rr, cc = stack.pop()
                cells.append((rr, cc))
                for nr, nc in ((rr-1, cc), (rr+1, cc), (rr, cc-1), (rr, cc+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and half <= nc < w and (nr, nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc] == color:
                        seen.add((nr, nc))
                        stack.append((nr, nc))
            min_r = min(rr for rr, cc in cells)
            min_c = min(cc for rr, cc in cells)
            shape = frozenset((rr-min_r, cc-min_c) for rr, cc in cells)
            objects.append((color, shape))

    out = [row[:half] for row in grid]
    for cells, shape in cavities:
        color = next(color for color, obj_shape in objects if obj_shape == shape)
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
file=progdir/'task-fc9280a8.py'
file.write_text(code)
print(file)
